fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
The start time, read in each visitor's own zone

Kestrel Payroll schedules its product demo for Thursdays at 11 AM Pacific. A finance lead who opens the page in New York sees 2:00 PM Eastern, taken from her browser, with the Pacific time in small type underneath. Her confirmation email repeats the time in Eastern.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
When the live hour ends, the recording takes its place

Fieldnote ran its survey design session live for 412 registrants. Once the hour was over, the headline switched to Watch the Recording, with the form left where it was. Another 268 people have signed up since then, each tagged replay in the table and emailed the recording link.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
86 questions, grouped by topic for the moderator

Every registrant for Northwind People's panel on hiring without a recruiter can ask one question on the form. By the morning of the panel, 86 had come in. At 8 AM, the moderator, Lena Okafor, gets a direct message in Slack with them grouped by topic. Pay ranges lead with 31.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { liveProductDemo: "Build a registration page for our weekly product demo at Kestrel Payroll, every Thursday at 11 AM Pacific. Register each sign-up in Zoom through its API, then email the personal join link with a calendar file attached.", onDemandReplay: "My team ran a live webinar on survey design for 412 registrants. Now that it has ended, change the headline to Watch the Recording and keep the same form. Tag every new sign-up as replay in the registrant table, email each one the recording link, and show me live and replay counts side by side.", trainingSeries: "Build one landing page for our four-session onboarding series for new bookkeeping customers. List the sessions with checkboxes so each customer picks the ones they need. Cap every session at 100 seats. When a session fills, change its checkbox to Join the Waitlist and save waitlist sign-ups separately. Send one confirmation with a join link for each session picked.", panelDiscussion: "Build a registration page for our HR panel on hiring without a recruiter. Add an optional field where each registrant asks the panel one question. Group the questions by topic with a count for each. At 8 AM on the day of the panel, send the grouped list to our moderator, Lena Okafor, as a direct message in Slack." };
